{"inp":{"code":"# Encontrar quando MACD cruzou para positivo (MACD - signal >0) pela última vez
import numpy as np

macd_diff = df['MACD'] - df['MACD_signal']
# find indices where sign is positive
pos_idx = np.where(macd_diff>0)[0]

first_pos = df['date'].iloc[pos_idx[0]].strftime('%Y-%m-%d') if len(pos_idx)>0 else None
last_neg_before = None
if len(pos_idx)>0 and pos_idx[0]>0:
    last_neg_before = df['date'].iloc[pos_idx[0]-1].strftime('%Y-%m-%d')

print('First date MACD > signal in this series:', first_pos)
print('Previous date was:', last_neg_before)

# When MACD last crossed above signal (look for rising from negative to positive)
cross_dates = []
for i in range(1,len(df)):
    if (df['MACD'].iloc[i] - df['MACD_signal'].iloc[i])>0 and (df['MACD'].iloc[i-1] - df['MACD_signal'].iloc[i-1])<=0:
        cross_dates.append(df['date'].iloc[i].strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))

print('Cross dates (MACD crossing above signal):', cross_dates)

# Last bearish-to-bullish cross
last_cross = cross_dates[-1] if len(cross_dates)>0 else None
print('Last bullish MACD crossover:', last_cross)

# When RSI crossed 70 last
rsi = df['RSI14']
cross70 = []
for i in range(1,len(rsi)):
    if rsi.iloc[i] > 70 and rsi.iloc[i-1] <= 70:
        cross70.append(df['date'].iloc[i].strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))
print('Dates RSI crossed above 70:', cross70)

# Print a short summary of last 10 rows for context
print('\nLast 10 rows:')
print(df.tail(10).to_string(index=False))
"}}
